important_findings: Long-form current snapshots consistently use wide xkcd illustration packaging with a red What If? badge.
Shorts current snapshots primarily expose vertical animation excerpts and must be analyzed separately from long-form.
Labeled scales, diagrams, and concrete consequence scenes recur; explicit split comparisons are rare.
No current thumbnail pattern can be credited with historical performance because temporal alignment is unknown.
limitations: All 83 binaries are current remote snapshots retrieved after canonical title and metric observation.
No bytes are proven to match publication-time or metric-observation-time thumbnails.
Visual fields are AI_INTERPRETATION except measured dimensions, MIME, byte size, and SHA-256.
No OCR was used; small text transcription is not asserted.
Public metrics remain observational; no impressions, CTR, retention, watch time, or causal package effect is available.
Shorts thumbnail display varies by surface; stored image availability does not establish Shorts-feed ranking impact.

principles: Custom thumbnails are supported; Shorts display behavior varies by surface.
Native title/thumbnail A/B tests are unavailable for Shorts.
Native A/B winners use watch-time share, not CTR alone.
Changing packaging has no standalone algorithm reward; viewer response can change.
